items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 1 at 1:07AM PDT until November 3 at 8:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...An increased risk for sneaker waves and strong rip
currents.

* WHERE...Coastal North Bay Including Point Reyes National
Seashore and San Francisco Peninsula Coast Counties.

* WHEN...From late Sunday night through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
items.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.
